sin.name: line-outside-nudger
sin.description: A nudge's words are rendered outside the Nudger: the line reaches the agent unrecorded, past the feature switch that silences it and past its repeat span.
sin.rule: The journal speaks to the agent only through the Nudger: hand the Nudge to Nudger.deliver, refuse_with or answer, and send the words it returns. Only a command's own printed answer, the engine's refusal of a manual stack change and the shell conduct's comparison of tips already said render a nudge themselves.
